ownership.source_offset_scope: fixed x86 layout; not proposed portable API fields

catalog_views.source_binding_status: consumer offsets verified; complete producer/XML/installation meaning is pending

ordered_conditions: Clear an older pending preset first, setting manual marker if it had been active.
Scan game display names with __mbscmp and require exactly one name match; separately require type plus equal-length byte equality of display and secondary identity for the selected row.
Require exactly one realm display-name match in the global realm list and membership in the selected game's realm indices.
Require the record validator 0x429980 to pass.
If the per-type subrealm count is below one, require an empty optional subrealm field; otherwise require one matching name across subrealm rows and a matching type.
Require realm unavailable byte zero and game availability byte nonzero before publication.
admission.failure_before_publication: show rebind-required message; do not replace the stored selected record; the earlier pending flag/marker change is not rolled back
admission.comparison_scope: source byte/MBCS comparisons; no new case folding, fuzzy matching or ordinal fallback

application.rule: copy admitted record to main+0x10f4, set pending=1/manual-marker=0, clear normalized game-ID filter query and password/UI, clear 74 bytes at main+0x11ac and startup option main+0x2428
populate the ordinary game view, locate the catalog row through visible-to-raw mapping, then prepare the ordinary realm view and installation/path checks

after those helpers, require availability still true and controller current game equal to the admitted game; otherwise clear pending, set manual marker when applicable and show selection-invalid; prior effects remain
copy selected realm name into the normal controller field and call 0x40de40 with ECX=controller+0x120; clear normal subrealm string/current index
when required, copy name, call 0x40e0e0 with the same controller receiver, prepare subrealm view and its mapped selection
set main step 3 and call 0x42d120, then 0x417fe0; do not synthesize a successful login or game-ID reply

preparation_and_account.check_result_1: record saved step from 0x41c060, set preparation flag main+0x1a5e and temporary step, return 0; later preparation callbacks remain a separate analysis boundary
preparation_and_account.check_result_2: mark/clear pending preset, clear preparation flag and invoke ordinary error helpers, return 0
preparation_and_account.credential_presentation: when pending, assign preset field 5 into normal account main+0x21fc and clear password main+0x2200; the source prompt asks for a password
preparation_and_account.no_submission_here: this path presents the ordinary credential stage and focus handling; it does not call the credential-stage Next command

conditions: Ignore while normal login-in-progress main+0x1a74 is set.
Update normal input fields; when pending and account differs from the preset or option main+0x2428 is nonzero, mark/clear pending and warn, then continue normal login.
Require nonempty normal account and password.
Require ordinary prelogin helper 0x4285d0 return value 1; cancellation/nonacceptance clears pending and returns.
Require at least one ordinary authentication candidate; otherwise clear pending and report failure.
ordinary_submit.next: initialize normal candidate attempt fields and timer 100 at 100ms; call 0x4291d0

reply_and_game_id.nonpositive_reply_count: mark/clear pending before ordinary failure handling
reply_and_game_id.positive_reply_path: populate received IDs/state, call list rebuild 0x425790 and then preset consumer 0x418590
ordered_rules: Return immediately if pending is zero.
Copy the selected record to a local record and clear pending/set manual marker BEFORE searching or invoking the normal Next handler.
Copy received ID strings into a temporary list and require exactly one equal-length byte match to preset field 6; a duplicate match invalidates selection.
Require the current normal account to match preset field 5 using __mbscmp.
Require status word 0 or -4 and at least one of restriction fields main+0x1278/main+0x1478 for that ID to be zero.
Map the raw received ID index to a currently visible row with 0x41b610; missing/hidden/unusable/ambiguous results remain manual.
On success set the ordinary list selection and call 0x41e420; its case 4 repeats eligibility checks, clears both preset flags, copies game ID to main+0x11cd and enters normal handoff preparation.
reply_and_game_id.raw_vs_visible_indices: 0x43e4a0 maps visible ordinal <64 to raw stored row ID, otherwise -1; 0x41b610 searches visible rows for a bounded raw reply index
reply_and_game_id.fallback_effect: clear visible selection for mismatch/ambiguity/unusable status; a missing visible-row mapping has its own source message; do not choose another ID automatically

normal_handoff_boundary.observed: step>=5 invokes existing 0x410c00; absent main+0x1a5f and no controller work may restore step 3; step 2 can skip optional subrealm to step 3

0x36a.purpose: keyboard/Caps Lock hint; main+0x1a6c stops it and main+0x1a72 gates hint processing

100.purpose: ordinary login progress 0x424cf0; handler stops timer when main+0x1a74 is zero

abort_and_reentry.normal_stop: 0x41b690 clears active request, in-progress/attempt fields and timer 100, and may post a window-close request; not a process-exit guarantee
abort_and_reentry.preset_reentry: the post-reply consumer clears pending before direct normal-command dispatch, so it cannot select the same preset twice through that flag
abort_and_reentry.scope: the listed static branches only; full late callbacks, dialog lifetime, preparation recovery and every host-close path remain pending

design_inferences: D1 can coordinate preset ownership with the existing shared launcher-flow/login/channel/replies/local modules, preserving source-specific rules and the real receive boundary.
Use the same normal selection/submit/game-ID path after applying a preset, with an explicit one-use pending selection and manual fallback; thin platforms should not duplicate authentication logic.
